To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a blockchain-based local energy market is technically feasible, and that the blockchain technology can serve as an information and communication technology in local energy markets.
we developed a blockchain-based local energy market that is able to balance generation and consumption and to distribute the surplus generation among all market participants.
we have designed and simulated a local energy market for 100 households that is based on blockchain technology and that is able to balance local generation and demand.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the technological, organizational and economic evaluation of local energy markets, as a promising approach for a more sustainable, decentralized and efficient electricity system.
a comprehensive concept and design of local energy markets as a promising approach for the sustainable energy transition in the future.
the development of a blockchain-based smart grid, which enables local energy markets to be established and operated.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the local energy market concept, market design, blockchain-based information and communication technology and the preliminary economic evaluation are promising and should be further investigated in the future.
a private blockchain is an adequate information and communication technology to realize a local energy market.
the presented blockchain-based smart grid concept and simulation is a first step towards a local energy market that can provide a more decentralized and sustainable energy system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a blockchain based smart grid concept that enables the local energy market and provides a decentralized platform for trading locally produced energy generation.
we present a blockchain-based smart grid concept for a sustainable local energy market, which can be used to evaluate the impact and potential of blockchain technology for local energy markets.
we present a comprehensive concept for the design of a local energy markets based on blockchain technology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
local energy markets have the potential to enable a more sustainable energy system, as they can balance the volatile and decentralized local generation with local demand.
local energy markets can be designed and implemented with blockchain technology, which is a promising technology to realize local energy markets.
blockchain technology is a promising technology for local energy markets.
